record_time_semantics: Actual protocol preparation time, before July outcome use. Data cutoffs below are simulated information boundaries, not claims of historical deployment or execution.
split_policy: Assign the entire tenant/trip by original role and local actual-departure date using metadata only. July10 trips retain snapshots after midnight. Buffer, original excluded and final-test groups remain recorded with reasons and have no P05 label cutoff. Frozen heldout vehicles/routes cannot enter training or July calibration/assessment.
base_refit: Refit the already selected ETA candidate, historical fallback, independent logistic classifier and prevalence fallback on original training only. Fit new full-training preprocessing without July rows or labels. No new model-family, feature or hyperparameter selection.

eta.score: For each eligible supported snapshot use max(raw_lower_seconds-target_seconds,target_seconds-raw_upper_seconds,0); each trip contributes the maximum of its nonnegative snapshot scores.
eta.rank: ceil((n_fit_trips+1)*nominal_coverage), one-indexed; use the observed order statistic with no interpolation. A rank beyond n has insufficient support.
eta.median_policy: Unchanged raw median; calibrated endpoints are coverage bounds, not newly fitted P10/P90 quantiles.
eta.scope: One calibrator per tenant for the fixed delivered ETA pipeline, including its declared historical fallback. Retain native/fallback source counts and source-stratified assessment.
eta.target_eligibility: Latest verified gate arrival known strictly before the role label cutoff, second/minute precision and positive exact remaining time; retain exclusions. No service or delivery completion substitute.
eta.unsupported: Keep raw interval with calibration_status=unsupported; do not call it calibrated.
eta.guarantee_boundary: Trip-max is a grouped adaptation of split CQR. The finite-sample argument requires exchangeable whole-trip scores. Temporal, vehicle/route dependence and maturity selection are not established exchangeable here; report empirical assessment, not guaranteed fleet coverage.

probability.fit_weighting: Each eligible supported tenant/trip has total weight one divided among its eligible snapshots. Class-contributing trip counts may overlap for revised promises. No class balancing.
probability.objective: SUM_i(weight_i*binary_cross_entropy_i)+0.5*((a-1)^2+b^2); do not divide by number of trips.
probability.numerics: Use stable logaddexp cross entropy and stable sigmoid. Invalid input, nonfinite or nonconverged optimization is an error, not support fallback.
probability.scope: One calibrator per tenant on the fixed delivered classification pipeline including its declared prevalence fallback. No silent cross-tenant pooling.
probability.target_eligibility: Preserve M3c second-precision, independently evidenced gate-arrival binary target against snapshot-effective promise; no grace, unknown/cancelled/immature/already-arrived are unscored.
probability.unsupported: Identity fallback copies raw probability exactly, without clipping it, and records calibration_status=unsupported. Probability clipping applies only inside fitted sigmoid calibration.
probability.rank_boundary: Slope zero and numerical clipping/saturation can create ties. Tenant-specific mappings can alter ranking across tenants; no overall AUC invariance is claimed.

assessment.selection_role: Independent of calibrator fitting and base training. Predeclared later use as the P06 policy-development pool is allowed; it is not an independent final-policy test.
assessment.frozen_decisions: Do not select/calibrate on assessment outcomes, switch methods by observed GPS slices, change cutoffs/minimum supports, or refit calibrators on all July while retaining these held-out assessment claims.
assessment.weighting: Within each reported cohort or slice, each scored tenant/trip has total weight one across its snapshots. Report all-opportunity availability and explicit exclusions separately.
assessment.single_class_ranking: ROC AUC and average precision null with reason; probability losses remain defined.
assessment.fit_metrics_label: No before/after calibration-fit evaluation is run. Fit diagnostics are limited to fitting objective, trip scores, support and provenance; the calibration application guard rejects calibration-fit trip identities.
assessment.uncertainty: Do not infer operational benefit, conditional per-GPS coverage or calibrated performance on future fleet data from this synthetic assessment.
assessment.eta_metric_semantics: All-eligible-trip coverage counts a trip as missed if any eligible snapshot lacks an interval or is outside it. Full-availability coverage restricts to trips with intervals for every eligible snapshot. The alpha=0.2 interval score is width+10*(lower-target) below lower or width+10*(target-upper) above upper. Median predictions and median MAE are unchanged.

protected_periods: Never pass July11-14 buffer targets or August-September final-test targets to fit/assessment/scoring. Original heldout entities remain protected even when dates fall in training or July.

replay.scope: Source identities, roles, support and fallback decisions exact; fixed-runtime repeated outputs compared separately from bounded portable inference.

method_references.title: Conformalized Quantile Regression, Romano et al. (2019)
method_references.scope: CQR score/order-statistic construction and exchangeability premise; whole-trip max aggregation is this protocol adaptation.

method_references.title: scikit-learn 1.8 probability calibration
method_references.scope: Disjoint base/calibration data, sigmoid approach, small-sample isotonic caution and limits of Brier as calibration-only evidence.
